name: fairbuild-lien-waivers
description: Fairbuild Lien Waivers: every payment to a subcontractor or supplier matched to its lien waivers: payments made without a conditional waiver, unconditional waivers missing after the payment cleared, waivers for less than was paid, unsigned waivers, and final payments without final waivers. Drafts waiver requests. Never files or releases a lien and never pays.
